dialog.text: /angry I am Executive MacKellan, I know you are here to find out about the gates to other Galaxies. They are down due to the PSIs, report any "Psi-tings" at once. *chuckle* Your security clearence isn't high enough to know any more... Off with you. Oh, there might be some profit for ye with good weapons and ammunition. The Progen are itchin' for a fight with these so-called "V'rix".

replies.text: Pfft, I can build better weapons than you.
No one's better than you huh?

dialog.text: /happy1 The name is Javier, and you?

replies.text: Me, I'm Macboytt. Nice to meet you.

dialog.text: /bow Hi there! I'm Sondra, step right up and get yourself some Net-7 newspaper! There are many stations you can run them to and you might even pick yourself up a nice paycheck if you're quick about it.

dialog.text: /salute Welcome Macboyje. The Jenquai race is always welcome at my booth. Which level 4 components do you want to buy?
/happy1 Macboyje right?  I remember you... Good conversation. Enigmatic. Enigmatic is good.

Hhhmph. You're not a Reclaimer, are you? What brings you down here to the great halls of science and learning, stranger? Whatever it is, I hope you have a strong stomach. I've been hip-deep in the vilest of effluvia all day today. Still, it's good to see a new face. I'm Reclaimer Ort. Let's chat for awhile, shall we? Try not to let the stench of my clothes bother you. What's your name?

replies.text: I am Macboyje.  Nice place you have here.

dialog.text: /happy1 I offer shield building implants for those with the right prerequisites.
/sigh  Who are you with?  Conservationists?  Hunters?  Glenn Commission?
Heyhowdy there, friend. Still slumming on Orsini? Say, stop me if you've heard this one--a Progen, a Terran, and a Jenquai are riding in a transport when...
Hail Macboyje!
Hail Centurion!
I'm in the middle of something.

dialog.text: /salute Welcome Macboyje. The Jenquai race is always welcome at my booth. Need some level seven components?

So traveler, I bet you're wondering what this station's all about? Xipe Totec contains some of the most sophisticated technology of the Jenquai. The dangers of this sector should make this area uninhabitable, but our technology provides us our home.

I'm sure you know, but as isolated and dangerous as this station is, it's still an important trade route. That's why I'm here. I'm a representative of Infiniticorp's interest in the Sirius System. It's a great job, but sometimes I get a little tired of this isolation.
/bow I am Sai'li Raushna, Oni researcher of the past four years.

replies.text: I don't feel like learning right now.

dialog.text: Hi there, young Jenquai. I am a high ranking executive of InfinitiCorp. With that in mind my time is very precious to me. What do you need?

replies.text: What do you think about the recent problems with the gates?

dialog.text: *mumbling* Damn MacEwens, n'er did lik' their kind. Alwa' smellin' up the place. Anyway, whaddaya want wif me?

replies.text: What do you think's causing all this tension in the galaxy?

dialog.text: Vho're you? Vhy're you here?

replies.text: I'm Macboyje and I'm here to help you.

dialog.text: Hello there. What's your name? Hm.. that doesn't seem to be on my itinerary. What job are you a part of?

replies.text: Job? I don't need no stinkin' job. I'm in business for myself!
